Why it matters: The charge had been a bothersome footnote for Womack since her sudden rise from obscurity on Election Day, when she unexpectedly won a heavily Republican district. Womack, a 49-year-old minister and consultant, is one of several "wave babies" who were largely unknown to national Democrats before their upset midterm victories.
